
advisory.summary: Do not rely on client-side secret verification. Use server-side asymmetric challenge-response authentication, hardware tokens, or salted cryptographic hashes.

advisory.summary: Never trust client-originating IP headers from untrusted connections. Configure the reverse proxy to strip incoming 'X-Forwarded-For' headers and only set them using the actual connection socket address ($remote_addr).
